protocol.inquiry: Neutral own-account or transaction fact request without an asserted problem.
protocol.dispute: Asserted unrecognized, incorrect, or duplicate charge; missing refund; or money deducted but not received.
protocol.human: Explicit person request, asserted immediate security/fraud/account-takeover/phishing incident, legal threat, or vulnerability/coercive control.
protocol.other: Outside the chosen account/transaction support scope, including product information, opening an account, branch facilities, general education, or conversation.
protocol.negation_rule: A negated incident or person request alone does not trigger human.
